limitations: PASS means complete bound data and reproduced calculations; screening checks may all or partly fail.
20 independent map clusters per cohort; unadjusted intervals and two fixed training starts are not a training-population effect.
No V14 comparison, promotion, automatic next experiment or extra games is authorized.
CSV arithmetic and recorded process/source/hash history are audited, not unarchived gameplay trajectories or actual runtime agent configs.
Production Agent_x and common self loading paths are bound source; separate runtime-config integration checks remain distinct evidence, not replayed here.
Historical training PASS is preserved as a sealed prior audit, not reexecuted after the source changed.
Tensor copies are safely loaded and byte/typed-content checked; no model construction, forward or optimizer work.
Root must separately confirm OS-level process exit and authorize execution; a final JSON state alone is not an OS liveness probe.
Freshness remains limited by the historical seed audit's external/seedless coverage.
